stemMd: A hospital's waiting time fell in each of its two departments, yet its overall average waiting time rose. Which information could explain this?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A much larger share of patients attended the department with the longer waits.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Both departments treated exactly the same patient shares as before.

options.label: C
options.textMd: All waits in both departments became identical.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The units changed from minutes to metres.

explanationMd: An overall average weights departmental averages by patient counts. A shift towards the slower department can outweigh improvements within both departments. Compare weights as well as component averages.

distractorRationale.e: An average would not be defined.
distractorRationale.c: Then the weighted average cannot exceed that common value.
distractorRationale.b: Fixed weights would preserve the direction of both improvements.
distractorRationale.d: This is a measurement error, not a valid weighted-average explanation.
